value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#29
value.text: Taina is a terminally ill girl and Spider-Man's biggest fan, and meeting him is her wish. He tells her how he got his powers and takes her web-swinging.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Taina's hero, who tells her his story.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#30
split.text: Taina helps Spider-Man recover his memory from Doctor Octopus, and he unmasks for her. Meeting him was her last wish.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's biggest fan. Saves him and learns his name.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Taina's hero, who shares his secret with her.

verdicts.why: They meet in #29, where he tells her his origin and takes her web-slinging; her rescue of him from Doctor Octopus and his unmasking are #30, so those facts move to a #30 stage instead of being dropped.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#5
value.text: Detective Terri Lee teams with Spider-Man to expose Mysterio.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
split.text: Terri helps Spider-Man and Blade against Morbius. When Peter is framed, she suspects he is innocent, and Spider-Man saves her when Carnage drains her life force.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A police detective and Peter's ally.

verdicts.why: They team up against Mysterio in #5 (Morbius #23, the frame-up #33, Carnage #38), so the move is right but the later facts go to a split stage on the old title.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
value.text: Spider-Man races the Kingpin to find the aging Six American Warriors, then fights beside them against the Insidious Six.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#58
split.text: Spider-Man fights beside the Six American Warriors against the Red Skull and Electro.
split.on_a_card_about_b: World War II heroes Peter helps and fights beside.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The young hero who fights beside the Warriors.

verdicts.why: #57 has Spider-Man and the Warriors fighting the Insidious Six; Electro and the fight with the freed Red Skull are #58, so those go to a split stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
value.text: Spider-Man summons the Thing to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Brings Ben to fight on Battleworld.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
split.text: Spider-Man leads the rescue when Doom kidnaps the Thing.
split.on_a_card_about_b: On Peter's team on Battleworld.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the rescue when Doom takes Ben.

verdicts.why: Spider-Man summons the Fantastic Four in #61 and Doom kidnaps the Thing in #63, so the rescue becomes a #63 split stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#26
value.text: Adrian Toomes, an aging inventor, becomes the Vulture and drains Spider-Man's youth.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#54
split.text: Left with Spider-Man's mutation after draining him, the Vulture later joins the Kingpin's Insidious Six against Spider-Man.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Steals Peter's youth.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The hero whose youth the Vulture steals.

verdicts.why: Toomes becomes the Vulture in #26 and #27 opens with Spider-Man aged by his talons; he absorbs the mutation in #27 and joins the Six in #54, so those facts go to a #54 split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#24
value.text: Tombstone, a mob enforcer, beats Spider-Man and kidnaps Dr. Connors for Silvermane.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A mob enforcer who beats Peter.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#42
split.text: Tombstone is Robbie's childhood friend turned enemy. Spider-Man jails him for using Robbie's son, then stops his escape with Richard Fisk.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A mob enforcer from Robbie's past.

verdicts.why: Tombstone debuts in #24 sent after Connors; the Robbie backstory and jailing are #36 and the escape with Richard Fisk is #42, so they go to a #42 split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#3
value.text: Wilson Fisk is a respected philanthropist who is secretly the Kingpin, the crime lord who funds the Spider-Slayers sent against Spider-Man.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The crime lord who funds the Spider-Slayers.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#34
split.text: The Kingpin is behind the Insidious Six and many of Spider-Man's other foes. He has his son Richard frame Peter, and Daredevil then reveals Fisk's secret to Spider-Man.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The crime lord behind most of Peter's troubles.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The hero who keeps ruining Fisk's plans.

verdicts.why: Kingpin funds Alistair's Spider-Slayers against Spider-Man in #3; the Insidious Six (#14), Richard's frame-up (#33) and Daredevil's reveal (#34) go to a #34 split rather than being dropped.
#57: the Chameleon betrays the Kingpin and helps Kragov free their father the Red Skull, and the Marvel Database cites the same episode for the stepson and disguise backstory.
Kragov and the Chameleon free the Red Skull in #57; the Electro transformation and betrayal are #58 and are carried by the separate N5 stage.
In #58 the doomsday device turns Kragov into Electro and he betrays his father and stepbrother, a real turn from family to enemy.
#57 ends with both sides trapped by the freed Red Skull as Silver Sable arrives to help Spider-Man; #58 has them already tracking the Skull.
The Warriors' war with the Skull is told in #56 and he is freed and traps them in #57, the first title where the whole text (including 'again when he is freed') holds.

value.text: In World War II, Logan and Captain America come for a scientist at the Red Skull's base. The Skull captures them, but they escape and wreck his giant robot before he flies off.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Comes for the Red Skull's scientist with Captain America.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's enemy in the war, who captures him.

verdicts.why: Sources agree the scientist was there willingly and the Skull captures them before they beat his robot and he escapes by plane; the 'Sleeper' name comes only from the wiki, so it is left out.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#7
value.text: Mary Jane, Anna Watson's niece, goes to the Fall Formal as Peter's date, and the two become friends.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
split.text: Mary Jane transfers to Midtown High and becomes part of Peter's circle of friends.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's Fall Formal date, and a friend.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Mary Jane's Fall Formal date, and a friend.

verdicts.why: The Fall Formal is #7 and she enrolls at Midtown in #9 (Halloween), so the transfer goes to a #9 split.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#24
value.text: Mark is the brother of Peter's girlfriend Liz. As the Molten Man he fights Spider-Man, who tries to help him, until the Green Goblin shuts off his powers and he is jailed.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#25
split.text: Locked in the Vault, the Molten Man is powered up again by the Green Goblin and set loose, until he is knocked out with the other inmates.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Liz's brother, the Molten Man.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Mark and tries to help him.

verdicts.why: Mark becomes Molten Man and is beaten and jailed in #24 (Subtext); he is a Vault inmate only in #25 (Opening Night), so that fact moves to a #25 split.
Marvel Database gives Walter Hardy's first appearance as #12 (Intervention), which shows the burglar killing Ben and Peter catching him; the identity reveal is #25.
Norman offers Peter the mentorship after the thief Beck is arrested, which is #14 (Blueprints).
The unmasking, the framing of Harry and Norman leaving as Mr. Roman are all in the finale, #26 (Final Curtain).

value.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#2
value.text: After Peter saves her son from a Machine Man, Dr. Naoko Yamada-Jones lets him stay in her home, never knowing he is Spider-Man.

split.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#11
split.text: Naoko comes to hate Spider-Man after her clinic is wrecked in his fight with Venom and Carnage, never knowing he is Peter.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The doctor Peter lodges with, who hates Spider-Man.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Naoko's lodger, secretly the Spider-Man she has come to hate.

verdicts.why: Naoko first appears in #2, where Peter moves in with her and her son; the clinic and her hatred of Spider-Man stay on the old #11 title as a split instead of being dropped.

value.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#2
value.text: Karen O'Malley, the rebels' second in command, fights beside Spider-Man.

split.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#12
split.text: When the High Evolutionary's Machine Men kidnap Karen, Spider-Man and X-51 rescue her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A rebel leader Peter fights beside.

verdicts.why: Karen first appears in #2 when Spider-Man joins the rebellion; her kidnapping and rescue are #12, so they go to a #12 split.

value.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#5
value.text: Spider-Man saves the Machine Man X-51, who then refuses to hurt innocents and joins the rebels.

split.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#12
split.text: Spider-Man and X-51 team up to rescue Karen O'Malley.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Machine Man who joins Peter.

verdicts.why: X-51 defects to the rebels in #5 (Steel Cold Heart) after Spider-Man saved him; the Karen rescue is #12 and goes to a split.

value.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#1
value.text: May is Peter's widowed aunt, who he lives with.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#8
split.text: May works hard to pay the bills, and Peter keeps his Oscorp internship partly to help her. When he breaks down, she wishes his Uncle Ben were still there.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's widowed aunt.

verdicts.why: #1 has Peter living with his widowed aunt May; the bills and internship are #3 and the breakdown #8, so they go to a #8 split rather than staying on #1.

value.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#1
value.text: Peter saves Nico from an alien on his first day of school, and she becomes his best friend.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#9
split.text: Learning Peter's secret from Harry hurts Nico, but she forgives him after seeing him save lives.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend.

verdicts.why: #1 has the rescue and their friendship; Harry reveals the secret in #6 and Nico forgives Peter in #9, so that goes to a #9 split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#14
value.text: The Kingpin breaks Doctor Octopus out of prison to lead his Insidious Six against Spider-Man.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#43
split.text: The Kingpin later takes Doctor Octopus on again to get the super soldier formula, and Octopus brings him Felicia.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Fisk's Insidious Six.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Frees Doctor Octopus and hires him.

verdicts.why: Kingpin frees and hires Doctor Octopus for the Insidious Six in #14; the Hardesky, formula and Felicia plot is #43-44, kept as a split on #43.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#14
value.text: The Kingpin breaks the Chameleon out of prison to join his Insidious Six against Spider-Man.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#43
split.text: The Kingpin uses the Chameleon to steal John Hardesky from S.H.I.E.L.D.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's master of disguise.

verdicts.why: The Chameleon is broken out for the Six in #14; the Hardesky theft is #43, kept as a split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#35
value.text: Herbert Landon becomes the Kingpin's chief scientist in place of Alistair, and helps him turn Alistair into a cyborg Spider-Slayer.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
split.text: Landon makes Felicia the Black Cat for the Kingpin and stays at his side as the Six hunt the doomsday device.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's chief scientist.

verdicts.why: Landon replaces Alistair as chief scientist and cyborgs him in #35 (he only promised Kingpin a mutant army in #17-18); the Black Cat (#44) and doomsday hunt stay as a split on #57.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#24
value.text: Fired by Silvermane, Hammerhead goes over to the Kingpin.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#25
split.text: Hammerhead kidnaps Silvermane's daughter Alisa for the Kingpin.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Defects to Fisk.

verdicts.why: Hammerhead sides with Kingpin in #24, but the sources place the Alisa kidnapping after Tombstone's, with the hostage swap in #25, so it goes to a #25 split.
In #24 Silvermane sends Tombstone to abduct Vanessa Fisk and Connors, and #25 opens with Connors already taken.
#24 sends Tombstone after Connors and #25 opens with Tombstone having beaten Spider-Man and made off with him.
#54 ends with Silver Sable's Wild Pack taking the informant and leaving Spider-Man and Robertson with the bomb; #55 opens with the escape.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#36
value.text: Out for revenge, Lonnie lures Robbie to a chemical plant to frame him, but falls into a vat and comes out rock hard as Tombstone. Years later he pulls Robbie's son Randy into his gang to control Robbie, until Robbie and Spider-Man set Randy straight.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#42
split.text: From prison, Tombstone and Richard Fisk get Robbie framed.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Robbie's old friend, now out to ruin him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Tombstone blames for his years locked up.

verdicts.why: #36 (Tombstone) has the backstory and Tombstone using Randy against Robbie, so they are enemies from there; the prison frame-up with Richard Fisk is #42 and stays as a split on #42.
In #4 Marko overhears Cat and goes back to work for Silvermane, who uses him as muscle; #5 already calls him Silvermane's right-hand man.
Kingpin frees Mysterio for the Insidious Six in #14. No source has a robot Venom paid for by the Kingpin; in #50 Mysterio funds his work with robberies, so dropping that claim is supported.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#2
value.text: Oscorp is under the Kingpin's thumb. He orders Norman to destroy Spider-Man and threatens to take his company if the Spider-Slayer fails.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#31
split.text: The Kingpin forces Norman to build weapons for him, and as the Green Goblin, Norman turns on him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Owes Fisk, and works under Fisk's threats.

verdicts.why: In #2 Kingpin demands Spider-Man be neutralized and says he gets Norman's company if the Black Widow slayer fails. The weapons work and the Goblin turning on him are #31, so they go to a #31 split; the Hobgoblin plot is the separate #11 stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#11
value.text: Norman hires the Hobgoblin to kill the Kingpin, but the Hobgoblin sells him out to the Kingpin.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hires the Hobgoblin to kill Fisk.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The crime lord Norman tries to have killed.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#12
split.text: When the Hobgoblin turns on the Kingpin too, the Kingpin makes Norman help him strike back.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Has to help Fisk against the Hobgoblin.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Makes Norman help him strike back.

verdicts.why: The assassination plot and the Hobgoblin selling Norman out are #11, but the Hobgoblin's double-cross and Kingpin pulling Norman in are #12, so the stage splits at #12.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#8
value.text: The Rhino works for the Kingpin and steals the Promethium X for him.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#14
split.text: The Rhino goes to prison rather than betray the Kingpin, and the Kingpin breaks him out for the Insidious Six.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A loyal thug of Fisk's.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Rhino refuses to betray him.

verdicts.why: Kingpin sends the Rhino for the Promethium X in #8, but the refusal to betray him comes in the later lidium raid against the symbiote-suited Spider-Man, so that and the #14 breakout go to a #14 split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#33
value.text: Richard Fisk is the Kingpin's son and runs Fisktronics. He gives Peter a job, then frames him for selling government secrets.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#42
split.text: Richard goes to prison for framing Peter, and from there the Kingpin helps him frame Robbie Robertson.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's son, who runs Fisktronics.

verdicts.why: Richard frames Peter in #33 and is convicted in #34; the Robertson frame-up is #42 and stays as a split there.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#14
value.text: The Kingpin hires the Scorpion as one of his Insidious Six to take down Spider-Man.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#54
split.text: The Kingpin later reunites the Insidious Six, the Scorpion among them, to hunt a doomsday weapon.
split.on_a_card_about_b: One of Fisk's Insidious Six.

verdicts.why: The Scorpion joins the Six in #14; the reunion to hunt the doomsday weapon starts in #54, kept as a split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#9
value.text: The Shocker works for the Kingpin, sent to destroy the evidence of the shuttle crash and to win back the stolen Promethium X.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#47
split.text: The Shocker joins the Kingpin's Insidious Six and later helps Herbert Landon kidnap Morbius.
split.on_a_card_about_b: One of Fisk's hired guns.

verdicts.why: The Shocker debuts in #9 working for Kingpin and Alistair; the Insidious Six (#14) and the Morbius kidnapping (#47) go to a #47 split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#14
value.text: Silvermane plans to lead Hammerhead and the other crime lords in a war against the Kingpin.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#25
split.text: Silvermane and the Kingpin fight over the Tablet of Time, trading kidnapped family members.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A rival crime boss to Fisk.

verdicts.why: The war plot starts in #14; the Tablet of Time fight and hostage swap are #24-25, kept as a #25 split.
#54: Kingpin reunites the Insidious Six with the Vulture replacing Mysterio to find a doomsday weapon.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#64
value.text: Warren catches the thief Psylocke robbing his castle, and she knocks him out with her psychic knife before she is kidnapped for Apocalypse.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The thief who robs Warren's castle.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#66
split.text: Warren joins the X-Men to rescue Psylocke, and after Bishop frees her from Apocalypse, he admits he has feelings for her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The thief who robs Warren's castle and wins his heart.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Catches Psylocke robbing his castle, and later admits he has feelings for her.

verdicts.why: They meet in Promise of Apocalypse (#64), where she knocks him out and is taken by Magneto; the rescue runs through the later parts and his confession comes after Bishop frees her in #66, so those go to a #66 split.
In Come the Apocalypse (#10) Apocalypse and Mystique make Archangel a Horseman and lead him to Paris and Stonehenge, where he flees after Rogue absorbs part of his dark side.
Kevin escapes Muir Island in Proteus Part I (#56), the first XTAS episode with both Banshee and Moira on screen.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#48
value.text: On Asteroid M, Cortez betrays Magneto and frames Beast and other X-Men.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#71
split.text: Cortez kidnaps Jubilee for Apocalypse, and Beast rescues her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Frames Beast, and later kidnaps Jubilee.

verdicts.why: Cortez frames Xavier, Beast and Gambit in Sanctuary (#48-49); the Jubilee kidnapping and Beast's rescue are The Fifth Horseman (#71), kept as a split.
